calculate_asmd: calculate absolute standardized mean differences between sample and target DataFrames using weighted_comparisons_stats.asmd
compute_kld: compute KL divergence between sample and target distributions using weighted_comparisons_stats.kld
calculate_emd: calculate earth mover's distance between sample and target distributions using weighted_comparisons_stats.emd
compute_r_indicator: compute representativeness r_indicator from sample and target propensity scores using weighted_comparisons_stats.r_indicator
calculate_weighted_mean: calculate weighted mean of a pandas Series or DataFrame using weighted_stats.weighted_mean
